title: Tissue-Resident T cell and Tumor Interface
notes: This region displays a striking spatial interplay between a dense MART1-positive melanocytic tumor mass (red, volumetrically dominant) and CD8a-positive cytotoxic T lymphocytes (green) distributed both at the tumor periphery and interspersed within the tumor core. CD103-positive cells (white) appear as discrete focal clusters embedded within the CD8a and MART1 signals, identifying a tissue-resident memory cytotoxic T cell (Trm) population actively engaging the tumor. The pattern suggests an immune-infiltrated rather than immune-excluded microenvironment, with Trm cells positioned at direct contact sites with melanoma cells — consistent with active cytotoxic surveillance and potential antigen-driven retention.
